name: Lay It Bare!
source:
College students Taiyou and Rui have been in a long-distance relationship for a while now. While they've found and arrangement that works for both of them, this time, however, there's something strange about Taiyou...

[From [url=https://sp-abang.itch.io/lay-it-bare]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大学生Taiyou与Rui已经异地交往了一段时间。两人虽然找到了彼此都能接受的相处方式，但这一次，Taiyou似乎有些不对劲……
